intro: Global software development, cloud infrastructure, and technology sectors faced a concentrated wave of attacks between late April and mid-May 2026, with five articles covering the activity. Threat actors TeamPCP and PCPJack were observed exploiting five critical and high-severity vulnerabilities: CVE-2025-29927, CVE-2025-48703, CVE-2025-55182, CVE-2025-9501, and CVE-2026-1357. The campaign, assessed as three high and two critical in severity, impacted organizations worldwide across AI and automation verticals.
